You see Rotrender Hexed Scourge.

    Notes

    Same as Rotrender Scourge of Azzilon, but immune to all damage.

    Hexed Scourge has 3 other stages:

    • Rotrender Hexed Horror (immune to all damage)
    • Rotrender (same as Hexed Horror, but vulnerable)
    • Rotrender Scourge of Azzilon (with new spells, extra resistance, and extra damage)
